visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a light blue denim jacket stands on a bridge overlooking a railing during a vibrant pink and orange sunset. He holds a blue and red plush mascot with multiple eyes (Myaku-Myaku) and looks toward the horizon. White text overlays the center. (2) A montage of exhibits begins: a large pile of white suitcases with projection mapping showing the Louis Vuitton logo and colorful patterns; the man stands in a dark room looking at a wall-sized projection of a starry night sky. (3) The man, now in a white sweater, smiles at the camera with a large red balloon structure of the mascot behind him in an outdoor plaza. (4) A rapid sequence of various EXPO pavilions and objects follows: intricate wooden lattice architecture under a blue sky, an interactive screen showing animated forest animals, a small Astro Boy figure on a rooftop, shots of high-tech pavilions with flags (USA), a giant Gundam robot statue, and a small white humanoid robot with round eyes. (5) The man in the denim jacket interacts playfully with a performer in a brown polka-dot costume amidst a crowd near the wooden lattice structure. (6) In a bright indoor setting, the man takes a vertical selfie video while laughing, then shows a panda-themed mascot item in a clear package. He and a friend in a yellow t-shirt are seen walking through a brightly lit orange-pink curved hallway. (7) The man and his friend look at a smartphone screen, cheering with wide smiles and raised eyebrows while holding a mascot headband. (8) At an interactive display, photos of faces are labeled 'AGE UP', showing simulated aging. The man looks into the camera with a playful, skeptical pout. (9) Nighttime footage of a large outdoor fountain show with blue and white lights synchronized with music, followed by a drone show in the sky forming the words 'EXPO 2025 START!'. (10) The man holds up a boxed 'Myaku-Myaku Handy Fan' to the camera indoors. The final shot shows him and his friend running and dancing away from the camera on the bridge during a deep orange sunset, holding the plush mascot aloft. Social media handles appear at the bottom.
